description: Runs the full readiness check of one webinar and answers point by point what is ready and what would break in front of the participants: pages, dates (including a thank-you page that shows a different date than the campaign), emails and their timing, video source, the offer in the room, tracking and the form. Side effect: it stores the result and its history on the site, so the dashboard shows the same check; nothing else on the campaign changes. Use it when the host asks whether everything is ready, or before a launch. `force` runs it again although a recent result exists. For the numbers of a past webinar use wi_get_webinar_funnel_conversion_stats and wi_get_webinar_attendance_stats, this is about readiness. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

force.description: true runs the check even when a recent result exists.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.

name: wi_run_webinar_preflight
title: Run the readiness check before a webinar starts
